question: Which operative commands and bhaga epithets are added in this part of the mantra?
premises: The command drāvaya is applied to bhaga
The sequence is to be written
The epithets bhagāmoghe and bhageti are included
inference: The mantra adds a command to activate bhaga along with unfailing bhaga epithets.
plain_english: Add ‘bhagaṃ drāvaya’, and having written it, include ‘bhagāmoghe’ and ‘bhaga’.
